column1: # ZAP Baseline rule tuning — PHR API
# Actions: IGNORE (never report) / WARN (report, fails the baseline) / FAIL (report as a failure)
# A rule that is not listed here defaults to WARN, and zap-baseline exits
# non-zero on any WARN. So this file has exactly one job: say which findings
# the PHR programme has formally accepted. Everything else stops the release.

column3: Non-Storable Content — a JSON API is not meant to be cached. Accepted.
Application Error Disclosure — fires on any 500 status. The content leak is what matters, and rule 10023 catches that. Accepted.
